components.description: Authority Ring (Proof-of-Authority) admission and certificate production (paper §5.1).

components.name: suwappu-client
components.description: Rust client SDK for the suwappu-dag JSON-RPC query API.

components.name: suwappu-consensus
components.description: Mysticeti-C certificate DAG consensus + BFT linearization for the SUWAPPU DAG L1 (paper §6).

components.description: SUWAPPU DAG L1 cryptographic primitives: ML-DSA-65, ML-KEM-768, BLS12-381, SHA3-256, Poseidon2 (paper §3.3, §10, §12).

components.name: suwappu-execution
components.description: DAG block executor — wires the suwappu-db state substrate into the consensus pipeline (paper §7).

components.name: suwappu-fastpath
components.description: FastPay-style fast-path lane for single-owner Move objects (paper §6.4).

components.name: suwappu-faucet
components.description: Devnet test-token faucet. Single HTTP endpoint that signs Transfer intents from a seeded ML-DSA-65 faucet key and submits them via suwappu-client. Per-IP token-bucket rate limit reuses suwappu-mempool's LeakyBucket.

components.name: suwappu-indexer
components.description: Streaming indexer for suwappu-dag. Tails suwappu_subscribeEvents over WebSocket, stores commits in a queryable store, and exposes a thin HTTP API for explorers and analytics.

components.name: suwappu-l2-bridge
components.description: SUWAPPU L1↔L2 bridge — off-chain validation library for L1Lock / L2BurnProven Intent construction + payload validation. Substrate-side accounting in suwappu-execution (G3.2 #101).

components.name: suwappu-l2-confidential
components.description: SUWAPPU L2 PQ-confidential transfer primitives (Track H). Note commitment + nullifier + L2-address derivation. Phase 1 — viewing-key + hybrid AEAD encryption land in phase 2.

components.name: suwappu-l2-sequencer
components.description: SUWAPPU L2 sequencer (Track G G4.2). Phase 1: pure batch-construction logic + tx mempool. Phase 2: JSON-RPC service + axum daemon binary.

components.name: suwappu-l2-verifier-precompile
components.description: SUWAPPU DAG L1-side verifier precompile for the SP1-zkVM L2 (Track G Phase G2 #97). Stateless function: verify_l2_batch(proof, public_inputs, vk_hash) -> Result<()>. Filecoin/op-succinct shape.

components.name: suwappu-ltp
components.description: Lattice Transfer Protocol attestation pipeline + super-node integration (paper §10).

components.name: suwappu-mempool
components.description: Priority + rate-limited mempool for suwappu-dag. Replaces the FIFO pending_intents channel between client ingress and the round-driver.

components.name: suwappu-mldsa-precompile
components.description: On-chain ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204) signature-verification precompile core for the Suwappu bridge. PQ-sound; wraps the NIST PQC reference verifier with EVM-friendly I/O.

components.name: suwappu-node
components.description: Top-level SUWAPPU DAG node binary: composes all layers into a running validator.

components.name: suwappu-precompiles
components.description: Application-layer precompiles: registered-issuer, DID, policy-vocabulary, reserve-coverage (paper §8).

components.name: suwappu-rpc
components.description: JSON-RPC query API for the suwappu-dag node. Phase 2.1 read-only MVP.

components.name: suwappu-transport
components.description: Inter-validator transport — SCION + RaptorQ erasure coding (paper §6.3).

components.name: suwappu-validator
components.description: Validator Ring (Proof-of-Stake) ratification and slashing (paper §5.2).

components.name: suwappu-validator-program
components.description: Testnet validator points-accumulator daemon. Probes seed + external validators for uptime, ingests their event-log uploads, computes the public POINTS.md formula, and serves a leaderboard HTTP API at program.testnet.suwappu.bot.
